perfume.answer: Royal Jordanian lists perfumes, hair sprays and colognes as items that may go in carry-on or checked baggage but only up to limits on quantity. Through security, perfumes and other liquids must be in containers of 100 ml or less in one sealed transparent 1-litre bag.

sections.h: 🧴 What Royal Jordanian says about perfume and aerosols
sections.p: From the Royal Jordanian Baggage restrictions page, read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Royal Jordanian rule
rows: Allowed in carry-on or checked baggage but restricted to specific limits on quantity or dimensions
Perfumes, shaving foam, deodorants, gels, sprays, shampoo, lotions, creams, oils and drinks in containers of 100 ml or less
One transparent re-sealable 1-litre plastic bag per passenger, completely sealed
Show the items at the security check
Medicines and baby food needed on the flight
Do not need to go in the plastic bag

list: Not on the page: the page names the category of limited articles but gives no weight or litre figure for checked perfume or aerosols.

faq: Can I take perfume through security on Royal Jordanian?
Yes, in containers of 100 ml or less packed in one transparent resealable 1-litre bag, one bag per passenger.
Are hair sprays allowed on Royal Jordanian?
Hair sprays, perfumes and colognes are allowed in carry-on or checked baggage within quantity limits, but this page does not state the figures.
